Hi Sofia / Monica —

Looping you in to hand off Pennridge (Marcus / Leah) — they committed to a September go-live window and we sketched an initial mutual action plan (attached). High level:

- Kickoff: target week of Sep 8 (proposed Wed 9/9, optional Thurs 9/10)
- Integration spike: Sep 10–17 (API access + sample payloads) — owner: Engineering (Pennridge) + Redwood infra
- Data sync & prefix caching config: Sep 18–24 — owner: CS (Monica) + Pennridge eng
- Validation & acceptance: Sep 25–29 — acceptance criteria: latency under 350ms p95 on sample set, embedding parity on 2 test queries
- Go-live / cutover: Oct 2 (final smoke tests Oct 1)

Attachments: Pennridge_MAP_v1.xlsx, Statement_of_Work_Draft.pdf

Action for CS: can you take primary lead on orchestration and confirm owners for each milestone? Also flag any immediate red flags on dates or deps.

Thanks — happy to join the kickoff if helpful.

Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Pennridge — kickoff agenda, MAP owners & proposed milestone dates

Hi Leah / Marcus —

Great to meet you (virtually). I’m Monica, the Customer Success lead on Pennridge. Per Ben and Sofia's notes, I’ve formalized a concise MAP below with clear owners and target dates. Please review and confirm availability.

Mutual Action Plan (owners & dates)
- Confirm SOW and procurement: target by Sep 6 — owner: Pennridge procurement (Marcus) / Redwood Sales (Ben)
- Kickoff meeting: Wed Sep 9, 10:00am PT — owner: CS (Monica) [Kickoff_Agenda.docx attached]
- API keys & sample dataset delivery: Sep 10 — owner: Pennridge eng (Leah)
- Integration spike (first pass): Sep 11–17 — owner: Pennridge eng + Redwood infra (Aditya)
- Caching & batch config (prefetch/prefix rules): Sep 18–22 — owner: CS (Monica) + Pennridge eng
- Validation tests (3 business days): Sep 23–25 — owner: Pennridge QA + Redwood QA
- Go/no-go review & cutover prep: Sep 28 — owner: CS (Monica) + Pennridge PM
- Final go-live: Oct 2 (target) — owner: Pennridge ops + Redwood operations

Acceptance criteria (minimum):
- API responses return within target latency (p95 < 350ms) on the provided sample queries
- Embedding similarity >= 0.85 on the two validation queries in the sheet
- No data leakage — KV cache and retention config reviewed and approved by security

Open questions / asks for Pennridge:
1) Can you confirm a single technical point of contact for API keys (name + email)?
2) Can procurement confirm the SOW sign date window (by Sep 6)? If not, please propose an alternate date that won't jeopardize the Oct 2 go-live.
3) Any blackout dates for Pennridge ops between Sep 10–Oct 2?

If that all looks good I’ll send the kickoff invite and a shared calendar with milestone reminders.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on a smooth launch.

Monica Patel
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0789

Hi Monica / Sofia —

Thanks — the plan looks solid. Quick answers:
- Technical POC: Leah Park (that’s me) — I’ll own API keys and provide sample payloads by Sep 10.
- Procurement: Marcus is working to finalize SOW; he said internal approval is likely by Sep 7 but wants Sep 6 noted as optimistic. If it slips a week, we can push the integration spike to Sep 17–24 and keep validation the following week.
- No major blackout dates for ops in the window, but we have a maintenance window Sep 20 02:00–04:00 UTC that could impact overnight batch runs — flagged for you.

Confirming kickoff Wed Sep 9 at 10:00am PT works for me. Please send the invite and any pre-read materials (I'll circulate to my eng/QA teams).
